title: Brooklyn Nets All-Star Ben Simmons Sounds Off On His Name Being Mentioned During Tory Lanez & Megan Thee Stallion Trail [Watch]
htmlContent:
Megan Thee Stallion and Tory Lanez's trail is underway and at the end of the opening statements, it's clear that Tory's defense strategy will be Kelsey who fired, and he didn't.

At the end of the opening statements, it's clear that Tory's defense strategy will be Kelsey who fired, and he didn't, according to TMZ.

His attorney, George Mgdesyan, told the jury that it was actually Megan and Kelsey Nicole fighting and that it was jealousy. He said Tory and Megan had a sexual relationship Something she denied in the interviews -- and suggested that Kelsey was upset because Meg had a history of stealing her boyfriends, including DaBaby and Ben Simmons.

Simmons posted a clip of Rick Ross to his Instagram Stories: The clip features Ross shouting “false accusations!”—comes from a promo for Rozay’s appearance on AEW Dynamite earlier this year:

Per The Shady Room, Simmons and Nicole don't even know each other.

 “Kelsey doesn’t know him at all.” 

Speaking of Simmons, he helped the Nets beat the Washington Wizards on Monday evening finishing the game with ten points, eight rebounds, and five assists. After the game, Nets coach Jacque Vaughn was asked about the team's turnaround after Steve Nash was let go.

“I think that’s the biggest thing: I think we’ve committed ourselves to playing for and with each other, and that started on the defensive end of the floor,” Vaughn said. “We just asked the guys to play hard. At the end of the day, you can cover up a lot of things by just playing hard. So we’ve taken that approach for most nights.

“Our approach. No matter who is playing, who is not playing, it’s today’s game, taking it very seriously and having a mental edge about us to start this game,” said Vaughn. “Guys should be well-rested and feel good about themselves. Plenty of juice. We should come out and try to take the first punch.”
